bench.name: leaf_xs3_mut1
bench.purpose: P3 MUT1 (x-store lane alias) on the shared x store must be caught by the lane/stream model
bench.cmd: bash rtl/hbm_next/sm/tb/run_leaf_bench.sh {RUN}/xs3_m1 3 1 0 -DHNX_XS4 > {RUN}/xs3_m1.out 2>&1; cat {RUN}/xs3_m1.out; ! grep -q 'MUTANT CAUGHT p3_m1_t0' {RUN}/xs3_m1.out

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp3lp3_xs3nd --out {RUN}/record/views/hnx_xs3 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: hnx_rp3lp3_xs3nd = hnx_rp3lp3_xs3n (same RTL hnx_xs3, macros, outline, rl1 on N per the pad-return plan) with the CLOCK ENTRY moved to the N-face centre x 280.716 (beside the N pin-flop mass; xs3 with clk at x 280.7 measured spread 59.0/57.9) to fix the xs3n r3 clock_rule FAIL (pin-flop spread TT 82.8 / FF 81.2 ps, clk at x 315.4); CTS: explicit small register-sink clusters (24 sinks / 50 um) so the dense N pin-flop band gets short leaf nets. rl1[504] takes the old clk slot x 315.372 (34.7 um shift of one pad-return bit). HNX-SM4 10-20, parallel variants xs3nc/xs3nd; bind the first that passes clock+GRT0.
